questions.stem: 剛開始，我不知道該如何跟著應援團喊口號，也不習慣大聲唱歌。
questions.answer: At first, I didn't know how to shout slogans with the cheer squad, and I wasn't used to singing loudly.
accepted_answers: At first, I had no idea how to shout slogans along with the cheering squad, and I was not used to singing out loud.
In the beginning, I did not know how to chant slogans with the cheer squad, and I wasn't used to singing aloud either.

questions.stem: 自從學會了應援歌之後，我已經成為全場最大聲的球迷之一。
questions.answer: Since I learned the cheering songs, I have become one of the loudest fans in the stadium.
accepted_answers: Ever since I learned the team's cheering songs, I have become one of the loudest fans in the whole stadium.
Since learning the cheer songs, I have become one of the loudest fans in the entire stadium.

patterns: 最高級（one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞）

1.explanation_zh: 「剛開始」說的是過去的情形，動詞用過去式。「不知道該如何…」用疑問詞＋不定詞 how to + 原形動詞：didn't know how to shout slogans；「跟著應援團」寫 with／along with the cheer squad，口號不只一句用複數 slogans。「也不習慣大聲唱歌」中文省略主詞，英文用 and 連接、主詞還是 I；「習慣於（做）…」是 be used to + V-ing，這裡的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 singing，不能寫成 used to sing（那是「以前常常唱」）。
evidence: 剛開始，我不知道該如何跟著應援團喊口號
1.strategy_zh: 「不知道該怎麼／什麼時候／去哪裡…」用 how／when／where + to VR；「（不）習慣做…」用 be (not) used to + V-ing，和「以前常…」的 used to + VR 分清楚。
hints: 切成四段：剛開始，我不知道該如何／跟著應援團喊口號／也不習慣／大聲唱歌
標的詞彙：know（知道，L1）、shout（喊，L1）、slogan（口號，L4）、squad（隊、團，L5）、sing（唱歌，L1）、loud（大聲的，L1）
句型框架：At first, I didn't know how to + VR …, and I wasn't used to + V-ing …

2.explanation_zh: 「自從…之後，我已經成為…」：since 子句用過去式（learned），或寫成 Since learning …，主要子句用現在完成式 I have become。「全場最大聲的球迷之一」用 one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞：one of the loudest fans in the stadium；loud 是單音節形容詞，最高級是 loudest，範圍用 in the stadium。
evidence: 自從學會了應援歌之後
2.strategy_zh: 「自從…」用 since + 過去式，主要子句用現在完成式；「…之一」用 one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞。
hints: 切成四段：自從學會了應援歌之後／我已經成為／全場／最大聲的球迷之一
標的詞彙：learn（學會，L1）、song（歌，L1）、become（成為，L1）、loud（大聲的，L1）、fan（球迷，L1）、stadium（球場，L3）
句型框架：Since + S + V-ed …, S + have become + one of the + adj-est + 複數名詞 + in …

common_errors.explanation_zh: be used to 的 to 是介系詞，後面要接動名詞 singing；used to sing 是「以前常常唱」，意思不同。
「大聲」是 loudly、out loud 或 in a loud voice；with big voice 是照中文直翻的說法。

traps.literal_error: At first, I don't know how to shout slogans with the cheer squad, and I'm not used to singing loudly.
traps.explanation_zh: 「剛開始」交代的是過去的情形，兩個子句都要用過去式（didn't know、wasn't used to）。

traps.literal_error: At first, I didn't know how to shout slogans with the cheer squad, and I wasn't used to sing loudly.
traps.explanation_zh: 「習慣於（做）…」是 be used to + V-ing，to 是介系詞，後面要接 singing；寫成 sing 就和「以前常…」的 used to + VR 混在一起。

1.restructuring_zh: 「也不習慣大聲唱歌」中文省略主詞，英文用 and 接第二個子句、主詞還是 I（I 可承前省略）；「不習慣＋動作」不能照字面寫成 not used to sing，要改成 be not used to + V-ing（I wasn't used to singing loudly）。
1.notes_zh: 「剛開始，我不知道該如何」：At first、In the beginning、At the beginning、Initially、At the start 都給分；「不知道該如何」用過去式 didn't（did not）know how to、had no idea how to、wasn't sure how to + 原形動詞。「跟著應援團喊口號」：shout、chant、yell slogans（cheers）with、along with、together with the cheer（cheering、cheerleading）squad、the cheer team、the cheerleaders，也可以寫 chant along with the cheer squad、follow the cheer squad and shout slogans、join the cheer squad in shouting slogans。「也不習慣」：and I wasn't（was not）used to、and wasn't used to（承前省略主詞 I）、and I also wasn't used to、nor was I used to、and I couldn't get used to 都給分；be accustomed to + V-ing 是同一個句型的同義說法（be＋形容詞＋介系詞 to＋V-ing），也給分。「大聲唱歌」：singing loudly、singing out loud、singing aloud、singing in a loud voice、singing at the top of my lungs，後面可加 in the stadium、at the ballpark、in public 等地點，句尾可加 either；be used to 的 to 是介系詞，後面一定接 V-ing。

traps.literal_error: Since I learned the cheering songs, I became one of the loudest fans in the stadium.
traps.explanation_zh: 「自從…已經成為」是從過去延續到現在的結果，主要子句要用現在完成式 have become。

traps.literal_error: Since I learned the cheering songs, I have become one of the loudest fan in the stadium.
traps.explanation_zh: 「…之一」要用 one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞，fan 要加 s。

2.notes_zh: 「自從…之後」寫 Since／Ever since + 過去式子句（I learned、I learnt，也可以用 I have learned），或 Since learning …；「學會了應援歌」可寫 learned the cheering songs，也可以寫 learned to sing（how to sing）the cheering songs；「應援歌」cheering songs、cheer songs、the team's (cheering) songs、team songs、fight songs、cheering chants 都可以；「已經成為」一定要用現在完成式 have (already、now) become；「全場」in the (whole／entire) stadium、at the ballpark、in the crowd 都給分；「最大聲的球迷之一」one of the loudest fans（supporters、baseball fans 也可以，noisiest 也給分），名詞要用複數。

1.translation: At first, I didn't know how to chant slogans along with the cheering squad, and I wasn't used to singing loudly.
1.explanation_zh: 「剛開始」用 At first（表示後來情況改變）；「不知道該如何」用 how to V；「跟著應援團喊口號」譯成 chant slogans along with the cheering squad；「不習慣」用 be used to + V-ing，to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 singing；整句是回顧過去，用過去式。信心 medium：「喊口號」也可譯 shout cheers／chant，「應援團」也可譯 cheering section／cheer team，不確定題組收哪幾種。

2.translation: Since I learned the cheering songs, I have become one of the loudest fans in the stadium.
2.explanation_zh: 「自從……之後，已經……」用 since 子句（過去式）＋主要子句現在完成式 have become；「全場最大聲的球迷之一」用 one of the + 最高級 + 複數名詞（the loudest fans）；「全場」指整個球場，譯成 in the stadium。

1.translation: At first, I didn't know how to chant along with the cheer squad, nor was I used to singing loudly.
1.explanation_zh: 「剛開始」用 At first；「不知道該如何……」用 know how to + 原形動詞；「喊口號」用 chant；「也不習慣」用 nor was I used to + V-ing（否定倒裝）；「應援團」譯為 cheer squad。

2.translation: Since I learned the cheer songs, I have become one of the loudest fans in the whole stadium.
2.explanation_zh: 「自從……之後，我已經成為……」用 Since 子句（過去式）搭配主要子句現在完成式 have become；「最大聲的球迷之一」用 one of the loudest fans；「全場」譯為 in the whole stadium。
